sources.repository: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique
sources.researchNote: The museum records neither photographer nor date, only the support and the size of the print. The name written across the image, “Monteux Jacques Jacob”, supplies the given names that the authority headings omit. The sitter appears to be in his twenties, which agrees with the application for membership of March 1926 preserved in the same file.

media.title: Jacques Monteux — SACEM membership photograph
media.description: Identity photograph from the membership file of the lyricist Jacques Monteux, inscribed across the top in ink “Monteux Jacques Jacob”.
media.altText: Studio identity photograph of the young Jacques Monteux in a dark suit, his name written in ink across the top.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The holding museum states only “© Fonds Sacem” for the print, which measures 4.5 × 3.7 cm and carries no photographer, studio or date. The watermarked digital copy published by the museum is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with the holding institution and the unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
